settings.heading: Some of the best moments of your day are the ones where your loved one is asleep on your heart.
settings.text:
They climb onto your chest, turn around twice, and go to sleep with their chin on your collarbone. You stop scrolling. You can feel a small, fast heartbeat against yours.

Heartside makes the things that go with that: their face on the tree, their name on a tag, and a soft sling for when their legs get tired.

settings.question: How does their photo get onto the ornament?
settings.answer: Upload it on the ornament's page and type their name. We fit the photo into the heart, print it on a 3-inch round ceramic ornament, front and back, and ship it to you.

settings.question: What kind of photo works best?
settings.answer: One where their face is close to the camera, in good light, looking at you. Phone photos are perfect. A person checks every photo before it prints, and if one won't print well, we email you before we make anything.

settings.question: Can I make one for someone else's dog?
settings.answer: Yes, and it's the best kind of gift. Any clear photo works, including one from their Instagram. Spell the name the way their person does.

settings.question: When will it arrive?
settings.answer: We print each ornament when you order it, then ship it anywhere in the US. The ornament's page shows how long that takes, and the Christmas order-by date goes up on this page as soon as our print partner confirms it.

settings.question: Is the 30% off real? When does it end?
settings.answer: Yes. 30% comes off every gift automatically at checkout, with free US shipping, until November 1. After that, standard US shipping is $5.99.

settings.question: Can I return it?
settings.answer: We can't take back personalized pieces unless they arrive misprinted, since each one carries one dog's face. Everything else can come back within 30 days. The details are in our returns policy.

settings.question: Do you ship outside the US?
settings.answer: Not yet. Everything ships within the US for now.

settings.question: What size dog fits the sling?
settings.answer: Dogs up to 15 lbs. It's a soft neoprene sling you wear across your body, with a pocket for your phone, in Charcoal.

settings.heading: Get the Christmas order-by date.
settings.text: One email with the date to order by for Christmas, and one before the 30% ends. That's all we'll send until then.
